test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B can complete a work in 11 days and 33 days, respectively. They started doing the work together, but after 3 days, B had to leave, and A completed the remaining work alone. The remaining work was completed in ______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A completes work in = 11 days

B completes work in = 33 days

Days worked together = 3 days

**Calculations:**

Total Work = LCM (11, 33) = 33 units

Efficiency of A (EA) = 33 / 11 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of B (EB) = 33 / 33 = 1 unit/day

Combined Efficiency (EA₊B) = EA + EB

⇒ Combined Efficiency = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

Work done in 3 days (by A and B) = Combined Efficiency × Days worked together

⇒ Work done = 4 × 3 = 12 units

Remaining Work = Total Work - Work done

⇒ Remaining Work = 33 - 12 = 21 units

Days A will take to complete the remaining work = Remaining Work / Efficiency of A

⇒ Days = 21 / 3

⇒ Days = 7 days

**Therefore, the remaining work was completed in 7 days.**
